error[VIBE1124]: The element `<template>` has no end tag.
  --> html/unclosed/input.vibe:1:1
1 | <template>
  | ^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Add `</template>` where the element ends.
fix: Write `<template />` for an element without content.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1124

error[VIBE1124]: The element `<p>` has no end tag.
  --> html/unclosed/input.vibe:3:5
3 |     <p>One
  |     ^^^
fix: Add `</p>` where the element ends.
fix: Write `<p />` for an element without content.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1124

error[VIBE1123]: The end tag `</div>` has no matching start tag.
  --> html/unclosed/input.vibe:5:3
5 |   </div>
  |   ^^^^^^
fix: Remove `</div>`.
fix: Add the missing `<div>` start tag, or fix the spelling of the end tag.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1123

error[VIBE1124]: The element `<span>` has no end tag.
  --> html/unclosed/input.vibe:7:3
7 |   <span>{{ open
  |   ^^^^^^
fix: Add `</span>` where the element ends.
fix: Write `<span />` for an element without content.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1124

error[VIBE1125]: An interpolation has no closing braces.
  --> html/unclosed/input.vibe:7:9
7 |   <span>{{ open
  |         ^
fix: Close the interpolation with two closing braces after the expression.
fix: Wrap the text in `<span v-pre>` to show the braces as literal text.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE1125
